summary: The diff implements JSON.stringify in crates/kahvi-builtins/src/json/stringify.rs as a close transcription of the spec. I walked the top-level steps 1–13, SerializeJSONProperty, SerializeJSONObject, SerializeJSONArray, QuoteJSONString and UnicodeEscape. Step order, the number of observable operations (Get, GetV, Call, ToNumber, ToString, IsArray, LengthOfArrayLike, EnumerableOwnProperties) and the ? propagation all match the spec. Cycle detection, indent/gap handling, surrogate handling, lowercase \uXXXX escaping and the undefined/"null" handling for arrays and objects are correct. Unsupported paths (Proxy via IsArray/Get, BigInt wrappers) go through ops helpers that throw not-implemented rather than returning made-up values. There are no test-specific branches. Nothing outside the in-scope file was touched; renaming unused parameters to _this/_new_target is a lint-driven change and fine.
